attchmntText: Rossell India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Rossell India Limited submitted copies of the newspaper advertisement titled Extract of Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026 to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. The advertisement was published on 11th November 2026 in Business Standard and Aajkal. The company filed this submission in compliance with Regulation 30 and Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Rossell India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosures for determination of the materiality of an event or information and making disclosures to the Stock Exchanges'.
voiceSummary: Rossell India Limited has authorized four Key Managerial Personnel to determine the materiality of events and make disclosures to stock exchanges. The designated individuals are Harsh Mohan Gupta, Executive Chairman; Digant Mahesh Parikh, Whole Time Director; Raunak Rathi, Chief Financial Officer; and Manish Shaw, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. This authorization was approved by the Board of Directors during a meeting held on 10th November, 2026. The contact details for these officials have been updated on the company website. The company submitted this disclosure to the SSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd pursuant to Regulation 30(5) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Rossell India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rossell India Limited board meeting held on 10th November, 2026 approved Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board approved the appointment of Mr. Azam Monem, DIN 00023799, as Additional Director, Non-Executive Independent Director, effective 1st February, 2027, for a term of 3 years, subject to shareholder approval. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr. Chetan Kumar Mathur, DIN 00437558, as Additional Director, Non-Executive Independent Director, effective 1st February, 2027, for a term of 3 years, subject to shareholder approval. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 12,835 lakhs, and profit for the period was Rs. 3,537 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 8.25.
